# Lesson digest — one line per hard-won lesson (bible/06 §7)

Full text: `genesis-ctx lesson <ID>`.

- L-001 [sdk-acp,config-secrets,core-engine,chat] — ACP MCP env MUST be a list of `{name,value}`
- L-002 [core-engine,sdk-acp,config-secrets] — `kiro_node` builds the real `KiroAgentOptions`
- L-003 [runs-worker,web-runs,api] — Keep the per-run SSE bus open until the run is TERMINAL; the client dedupes replayed history and CLOSES the EventSource on terminal final/error, else it reconnects and replays forever.
- L-004 [db,core-engine,runs-worker,api] — Data plane is SQLite, not JSON
- L-005 [runs-worker,core-engine,web-runs] — Use only the canonical event kinds (run.started, node.completed, agent.*, validator.result, retry.scheduled, gate.*, run.final, error) — there is NO node.started/node.failed; running = run.cursor.
- L-006 [web-runs,workflows-library,core-engine] — Workflows SHOULD declare a `graph:` topology whose node ids match LangGraph node names; without one, Run Detail derives a fallback from /steps so the graph is never blank.
- L-007 [web-runs,chat] — The transcript folds `agent.*` events into turns (`buildTranscript` → `groupTurns`, validator/retry notes on the just-closed turn); Markdown answers reuse the existing renderers — no new deps.
- L-008 [runs-worker,web-runs] — A generic `worker_exit` must NOT clobber a specific `error` event; empty-message exceptions report their type + a hint.
- L-009 [core-engine,runs-worker,workflows-library,kb-sync] — LangGraph: sync `invoke` can't run async nodes and sync `SqliteSaver` fails under async (use `AsyncSqliteSaver`); `Command(resume=…)` needs a checkpointer-compiled graph.
- L-010 [api,web-shell,web-runs] — ALL backend endpoints live under `/api`; the client prepends `/api` centrally and rejects non-JSON — uniform 500s on `/api/*` in the browser usually mean the backend isn't running.
- L-011 [web-runs,web-shell] — Mirror the event/gate/topology/steps contract shapes in `web/src/types` + the golden fixtures; a contract drift must fail a test (stubs must not hide the contract).
- L-012 [config-secrets,web-shell] — MCP/CLI settings detail needs BOTH the merged card view and the custom entry, joined by name; the curated tier is read-only, the custom tier editable.
- L-013 [workflows-library,web-runs] — `workflow.yaml` may carry UI-only keys (e.g. `graph:` topology); the parity lint exempts them via `YAML_ONLY_KEYS`.
- L-014 [web-shell] — jest-axe v9 ships no types: keep its ambient `declare module` + matcher augmentation in the existing pure-ambient `.d.ts` files; extend the matcher globally in `web/src/test-setup.ts`.
- L-015 [web-shell,web-runs] — Keep heavy web libs lazy (mermaid is dynamic-imported into its own chunk; Recharts is heavy too).
- L-016 [observability-credits,sdk-acp,runs-worker,chat,web-runs,core-engine] — Credits are REAL, not estimated (Phase 11 / ADR-032).
- L-017 [chat,security,config-secrets] — Chat trust is fail-CLOSED — never trust-all; build allowlists in the namespaced `@server/tool` form; a curated server with no `tool_allowlist` is capped only by the node's `tools=` list.
- L-018 [web-runs,chat,runs-worker,api] — sse-starlette frames SSE events with CRLF — a reader that splits only on LF-LF never parses a frame; accept both separators and don't let an LF-only test fixture hide it.
- L-019 [config-secrets,api] — Secret writes must be atomic + serialized (v0.20.1 crash fix).
- L-020 [core-engine,workflows-library,runs-worker] — LangGraph's default `recursion_limit` is 25 supersteps — a looping workflow needs the worker to set a higher limit from META; `attach_reliability` keys retries by agent NODE NAME.
- L-021 [core-engine,workflows-library,runs-worker,sdk-acp] — Never let a huge MCP result re-enter the context window: save it to the blackboard by reference (`save_tool_output`) and never paste tool output into the reply.
- L-022 [workflows-library,core-engine,web-runs] — Workflow graph.py with custom reducer state keys must NOT use `from __future__ import annotations`.
- L-023 [workflows-library,core-engine,appian-integration,runs-worker,config-secrets] — Parse saved MCP tool outputs DEFENSIVELY — real shapes vary per tool (Phase 12 live-run lesson).
- L-024 [chat,sdk-acp,workflows-library] — Kiro Skills load over ACP from the filesystem, NOT the wire (Phase 14 spike, 2026-07-16).
- L-025 [release-ci] — Pin the linter — unpinned `ruff` drifts and breaks CI on pre-existing code (Phase 16-02).
- L-026 [core-engine,runs-worker,db,kb-sync,workflows-library] — A blocking DB write inside an async node deadlocks the LangGraph checkpointer — do blocking `genesis.db` writes OFF the event loop (Phase 16-03).
- L-027 [release-ci] — Pin ruff in EVERY repo that runs `ruff check` in CI (16-08 recurrence of the 16-02 lesson).
- L-028 [config-secrets,appian-integration] — MCP introspection must allow a large `tools/list` line (16-08).
- L-029 [appian-integration,config-secrets,distribution,workflows-library] — Managed-native launch vs. env-resolution boundary (16-08, ADR-038).
- L-030 [release-ci,web-shell] — The genesis `frontend` CI job runs only on `changes: [web/**/*]`; a follow-up tag touching no web file does NOT re-run the stale-bundle guard — force it with a real `web/**` touch.
- L-031 [appian-integration,kb-sync,parser,config-secrets,api] — Match the real Appian Deployment REST contract for the export — read the vendor's own client, don't guess (16-07 live fix).
- L-032 [kb-sync,parser] — De-dupe KB objects by UUID — real exports repeat UUIDs (16-07 live fix).
- L-033 [workflows-library,distribution,runs-worker] — A newly-released library workflow must be `genesis install`-ed before it can run — and a missing workflow must not 500 (Phase 17-05 live).
- L-034 [kb-sync,web-shell,web-runs] — Rendering a real graph needs level-of-detail, not `fitView`-to-fit (Phase 17-05 live).
- L-035 [parser,kb-sync] — Parser dependency extraction must scan EVERYTHING, and "orphan" ≠ "unbundled" (Phase 18).
- L-036 [parser] — An Appian prefixed id `_a-<base>_<suffix>` shares its base with folder-siblings — base is a GROUP id, not an object id (Phase 18).
- L-037 [parser,kb-sync] — APPREF/ENTRYPOINT is a by-name cross-app integration mechanism (Phase 18, user-taught).
- L-038 [parser] — When porting a parser front-half, you may silently drop whole layers — diff against the source (Phase 18).
- L-039 [documents,api,db] — A repository list method must populate the SAME derived fields its single-get promises (Phase 19 live fix).
- L-040 [documents,kb-sync] — Google-native export → converge on the binary parser; auto-sync on add (Phase 19).
- L-041 [sdk-acp,chat,features-stages,core-engine] — An agent that must AUTHOR files needs BOTH cwd=sandbox AND the fs tool trusted — and know that fs writes vs tool permissions are separate gates (Phase 20, two live fixes).
- L-042 [chat,sdk-acp,features-stages,core-engine,workflows-library] — Give a CLI agent bulk context as FILES in its workspace, not as chat content (Phase 20).
- L-043 [features-stages,web-shell] — Embedding a 3rd-party browser SDK: prefer `postMessage`-host reuse over running its server (Phase 20, ADR-043).
- L-044 [chat,sdk-acp] — The Kiro ACP extension surface is richer than the public docs — spike the *installed* CLI, and prefer typed methods over `execute` (Phase 21).
- L-045 [chat,security] — Exposing the CLI surface in a "read-only" chat = refine the ADR, keep the human-confirm backstop (Phase 21, ADR-045).
- L-046 [chat,sdk-acp] — Route Kiro slash commands through the normal `prompt()` path, NOT `_kiro.dev/commands/execute` (v0.46.1 hotfix).
- L-047 [chat] — The chat MD export must match the REAL return shapes (v0.46.1 hotfix).
- L-048 [distribution,web-shell,appian-integration,config-secrets,api] — The built SPA must ship as PACKAGE DATA, and Dev-MCP enumeration must surface errors + paginate (v0.48.2).
- L-049 [config-secrets,appian-integration,workflows-library,distribution] — A managed-MCP bundle can silently disagree with the registry on env-var names (v0.48.2 / genesis-workflows v0.9.4).
- L-050 [kb-sync,appian-integration,parser,runs-worker] — "delta" sync = full re-export + LOCAL diff, not an environment patch; and a scheduled Appian export must be serialized (Phase 23).
- L-051 [distribution,release-ci] — Shipping = clone + git-tag self-update, browser-based — reuse Friday's model, verify against the real CLI (Phase 22).
- L-052 [distribution] — A launcher/process-control belongs in ONE place (Phase 22).
- L-053 [workflows-library,appian-integration,config-secrets] — A workflow that reads a core Appian credential must resolve it via the ADR-048 env seam, not `ctx.secrets` (v0.9.6 live fix, app↔workflow version skew).
- L-054 [documents,config-secrets] — A managed-native CLI's `--output` may be confined to the process cwd — set `cwd`, pass a relative `-o` (gws 0.22.5, Phase 19 live fix).
- L-055 [documents,web-shell] — Rendering a large parsed document to HTML on the main thread freezes the tab — show source for big docs (v0.50.2 live fix).
- L-056 [release-ci] — Verify the release commit contains EVERY changed file before tagging — a forgotten `git add` ships a test without its implementation and reds CI (v0.51.0 → v0.51.1).
- L-057 [release-ci] — When you bump a repo's tag, update EVERY transitive pin that must move with it — a downstream repo pinning an older shared dep reds CI with `ResolutionImpossible` (Phase 26 release, genesis-workflows v0.10.0).
- L-058 [features-stages,runs-worker,chat] — An app-process run→artifact bridge (StageFinalizer, ChatRunSupervisor) can miss a live terminal event — give it a level-triggered recovery AND make its failures loud (Phase 29 v0.55.2).
- L-059 [web-runs,runs-worker,core-engine] — A cursor jumping BACKWARDS in the live run graph is usually the bounded verify→revise loop, not corruption (Phase 29).
- L-060 [web-runs,runs-worker] — A completed run showed a mid-graph node stuck "Running" because the client `/events` fetch is capped and node status was event-derived (Phase 29 v0.56.0).
- L-061 [features-stages,runs-worker,chat] — A run→artifact finalizer that sweeps "all done runs" must scope to the stage's CURRENTLY-BOUND run, and never restart `serve` while a run is active (Phase 29 v0.56.2).
- L-062 [features-stages,runs-worker] — Generalize a run→artifact finalizer with a workflow→stage BINDING REGISTRY, and gate `start` on the run lifecycle — not just "in progress" (Phase 30 / ADR-058).
- L-063 [features-stages] — A prerequisite (gated) stage is an amendment to the parallel model — enforce it on BOTH sides + expect it to pull into the roll-up (Phase 30).
- L-064 [core-engine,workflows-library,features-stages,sdk-acp] — A single agent turn that must emit a large multi-part artifact will hit `turn_timeout` and TRUNCATE — decompose + assemble deterministically (Phase 30 post-ship, genesis-workflows v0.14.0).
- L-065 [core-engine,runs-worker] — A gate→END terminal path must set a terminal status, or the worker's snapshot leaks the resumed 'running' (Phase 30 post-ship).
- L-066 [web-runs,runs-worker] — Never derive the run-graph's node status OR its full conversation from the whole event log on every tick — it's O(events²) and stalls large runs (Phase 30 post-ship perf).
- L-067 [web-runs] — Pre-reverse back-edges of a cyclic workflow graph before ELK layout and route edges around nodes — ELK/dagre's own cycle-breaking scatters the validators (Phase 30 run-graph revamp).
- L-068 [web-shell,api,distribution] — Serve the SPA `index.html` with `Cache-Control: no-cache` (Phase 30 post-ship).
- L-069 [web-shell,web-runs,features-stages,stories-workbench,chat,documents] — `<Button asChild>` is broken in this codebase — never use it (Phase 31 live fix, v0.59.1).
- L-070 [config-secrets,appian-integration] — A stale server-scoped `appian-dev/LCP_URL` secret silently overrides the env-derived dev URL → a 401 against the WRONG Appian environment (2026-09-06 live).
- L-071 [collaboration-hub,features-stages] — A permissive local Hub emulator hid a real contract mismatch — the first live `stage_artifact` publish 400'd (2026-09-06, genesis v0.66.2).
- L-072 [collaboration-hub,features-stages,stories-workbench] — A read-only pull mirror must reconstruct local fields the frozen Hub contract doesn't carry — and the consuming UI must render a chat-less pulled artifact (2026-09-07, genesis v0.66.3–v0.66.5, collaboration puller).
- L-073 [features-stages,chat] — A chat-authored artifact's `html_path` is NULL until a milestone — resolve stage HTML via the sandbox-aware `_current_stage_html`, not the raw column (2026-09-09, genesis v0.68.1).
- L-074 [stories-workbench,collaboration-hub] — Auto-derived board membership + an always-on pull loop + a wrong default-status = a board that "adds everything and won't behave" (2026-09-09, genesis v0.69.0).
- L-075 [core-engine,workflows-library,features-stages] — A verify→revise loop that re-runs the WHOLE workflow (or can't touch frozen per-block content) is the single largest avoidable credit waste — add a second reliability tier that heals in place (Phase 40, ADR-067).
- L-076 [core-engine,workflows-library,features-stages] — Don't fan a single deliverable out into per-item agent turns when the items must be mutually consistent — you lose cross-item context (story-design-analysis v0.3.0, ADR-062 amendment).
- L-077 [kb-sync,parser] — Never merge a PARTIAL parse through a whole-app merge — guard it in the store, not only in the caller (Phase 45, 45-01).
- L-078 [kb-sync,appian-integration,collaboration-hub] — The live Appian side can differ from the documented contract — and from the local emulator — in ways only a live run shows (Phase 45-05/45-09).
- L-079 [kb-sync,parser] — Exported Appian XML can contain per-export random values — keep them out of change-detection hashes (Phase 45-09, F2).
- L-080 [kb-sync,collaboration-hub] — A watermark must be captured BEFORE the work it covers, and must not come from someone else's snapshot (Phase 45-06/45-08).
- L-081 [kb-sync,config-secrets,runs-worker] — A new default that turns a job ON must respect user edits and old consumers (Phase 45-07).
- L-082 [collaboration-hub,kb-sync,features-stages] — A pull must never re-apply a version this machine already holds — and one unresolvable record can pin a cursor for weeks (Phase 46-10 live finding).
- L-083 [features-stages,stories-workbench] — Test fixtures must use the real value shapes — a stub label without "§" hid a doubled "§§" (Phase 46-07 review).
- L-084 [collaboration-hub,appian-integration,features-stages] — Appian `a!fromJson` silently turns date-looking strings into datetimes; the Hub returns null text as `""` (Phase 46-09 Hub build).
- L-085 [collaboration-hub,features-stages,stories-workbench] — A client-side publish hook that nothing calls is invisible until a live two-machine check (Phase 46-10 F1, pre-existing since 38-04).
- L-086 [features-stages,chat] — Program-owned IDs inside agent-authored HTML stay stable when the normalizer edits only start tags (Phase 46-02).
- L-087 [release-ci] — Migrate a large doc corpus by MOVING text with scripts and adding a sidecar index — never by having an agent read and rewrite it; probe the real CLI before designing against its docs (Phase 47).
- L-088 [security,release-ci] — Guard agent shells with a command-parsing PreToolUse hook, not prefix globs, and test every guard with a bypass corpus AND a positive corpus (Phase 47).
